title: An investigation of licensing of datasets for machine learning based on the GQM model
findings: The paper does not analyze aspects of religion or faith. Its findings are focused on the complexities, ambiguities, and legal risks associated with the licensing of publicly available datasets used in machine learning systems, such as commercial unavailability and license incompatibility.
